title: Read Between the Wines Book Club
seo_title: Read Between the Wines Book Club in Ozark, MO
description: This December book club discusses The Christmas Party by Mikayla Davids, with festive cocktails, holiday wine pairings, a seasonal activity, discussion questions, and a suggested winter reading list. It takes place Tuesday, December 15, 2026 at 6:00 PM at Vineyard Market, 1759 W State Hwy J in Ozark, MO; regulars arrive around 5 PM for holiday treats and seats. Reserving a spot by phone or online is advised.
